notes:
Passed on the fake backend with python3 -m mhs.driver check (exit 0); evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware backend is declared and no hardware, Isaac Sim or sim-backend run was made. The card's family-config/GymnasiumDriver decision fits: the clone registers Gymnasium tasks, and the package serves the pointfoot flat task Isaac-PF-Blind-Flat-v0 whose config PFBlindFlatEnvCfg is the card's first entry symbol. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: none. The second entry symbol WFBlindFlatEnvCfg (wheelfoot) is not served by this one driver, and the rough, stair and play registrations are not served either. The registered entry point is the external omni.isaac.lab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv (__init__.py:64-71), so native names the card's config class and fake.py implements the Gymnasium environment surface; this follows the existing config-class drivers of the repository. The upstream task needs Isaac Sim 4.2.0 and Isaac Lab 1.4.0 with a GPU (README.md:7-8) and was not installed or run. The fake is the package's own pure Python kinematic stand-in (F0): its action scale, default joint positions, eight joint names, command ranges, 20 ms step and 1000-step time limit are read from the clone; the policy observation is a 185-value stand-in derived from the eight observation terms, eight joints and history_length 5. NOT COVERED: the real Isaac Lab observation space and its bounds, observation corruption, command resampling, the gait-phase computation and the velocity-command heading; those values are placeholders and no trajectory was compared with the upstream environment. NOT COVERED: the rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuators, sensors and terrain, the illegal base_contact termination and the reward terms. NOT COVERED: the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered task); it would need the upstream stack and the caller to import the registration, and it was not run. The action Box is unbounded because the clone configures no action clip and the real bounds come from the external ManagerBasedRLEnv / JointPositionAction implementation; no numeric bound was invented. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset); five G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close (native is a config class and the Gymnasium interface comes from the external base); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because the unbounded action space has no sourced numeric limit to probe; and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks and action.values). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No catalogue extension ids were used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line of the last gate run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
